user.title: Connect sScape
user.description: Connect an sScape API key. Saved places require places:read; for points without saving choose coordinates and use integrations:read with a key not restricted to places. An API-enabled plan is required.

data.use_coordinates: Use latitude and longitude without saving a place

data_description.host: Full origin, for example https://sscape.leofabri.com. Do not add /api/v1.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect sScape
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a key from the same account with the required permissions: places:read for places, unrestricted integrations:read for coordinates. Devices and automations are preserved.

places.title: Which places belong in Home Assistant?
places.description: Select only the places to import. Follow all also includes future places accessible with this key; it is optional. Excluded places remain in the sScape app.

data.follow_all_places: Follow all authorized places, including future additions

coordinate_target.title: A point without saving a place
coordinate_target.description: Uses the sScape geographic API. The point stays in HA configuration; no place is added to your account. Coordinates are sent to sScape to obtain the assessment.

error.invalid_host: Enter a full HTTPS server origin without a path, query or credentials. HTTP is only allowed on a local network.
error.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid, revoked or expired.
error.access_denied: Check that the key has places:read access and that your account plan includes API access.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the sScape API. Check the server address and try again later.
error.no_places: Add at least one followed place in sScape, then try again.
error.wrong_account: This key belongs to a different account. Use a key from the originally linked account.
error.select_places: Select a place or explicitly choose Follow all.
error.invalid_places: Select only places authorized by this key.
error.server_update_required: Update the sScape server to support explicit place selection.
error.coordinate_access_denied: Requires integrations:read, an API plan and a key not restricted to places.
error.invalid_coordinates: Check name, latitude (−90…90), longitude (−180…180) and radius (1–1000 km).

abort.already_configured: This sScape account is already configured on this server.

init.title: Places and updates
init.description: Choose the places to import. Empty selection with Follow all off imports nothing. Excluded entities are disabled without deleting history.

data.follow_all_places: Follow all authorized places, including future additions
data.push_updates: Push updates when supported by the server

coordinate.title: Coordinate targets
coordinate.description: Add or edit up to 10 points. Turn monitoring off to pause a point; HA history is preserved.

coordinate_details.title: A point without saving a place
coordinate_details.description: Uses the sScape geographic API. The point stays in HA configuration; no place is added to your account. Coordinates are sent to sScape to obtain the assessment.

local_sensors.title: Your local instruments
local_sensors.description: Choose the target for these instruments. Values stay in Home Assistant and do not alter sScape assessments.

local_sensor_details.title: Select outdoor sensors
local_sensor_details.description: Bind only weather instruments at this location, not indoor sensors or forecasts. Units are checked and converted. Missing or stale readings never become zero. A counter is not interpreted as rain rate.

data.rain_counter: Rain counter, period defined by the sensor
data.confirm_outdoor: I confirm these are outdoor weather instruments for this target

notifications.title: One notification per episode
notifications.description: Optional. Groups places only when sScape supplies the same event ID and source. No startup replay or all-clear inferred from missing data. Uses a notify service, for example the Companion App.

assist.title: Ask Assist
assist.description: Use phrases such as “sScape briefing at Home” or “sScape rain forecast at Home”. Works with the built-in Home Assistant agent. Requires exposed entities and read permission. Optional aliases: one line “Place name = home, garden”. Ambiguous names are not answered.

data.assist_allow_anonymous: Allow requests without a user identity, such as shared voice satellites
data.expose_selected_entities: Expose risk and weather of selected targets to Assist now

error.invalid_places: Select only places belonging to this account.
error.invalid_coordinates: Check name, latitude (−90…90), longitude (−180…180) and radius (1–1000 km).
error.outdoor_required: Confirm these are outdoor instruments at the target.
error.invalid_local_sensor: Sensor missing, incompatible units, or an sScape forecast.
error.invalid_aliases: Use one line “Place name = alias, another alias”. The name must match exactly one selected target.
error.coordinate_access_denied: Requires integrations:read, an API plan and a key not restricted to places.
error.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid, revoked or expired.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the sScape API. Check the server address and try again later.

abort.invalid_auth: Check the API key and authorized places.
abort.cannot_connect: sScape is unavailable. Try again later.
abort.invalid_places: Select only places belonging to this account.

gust_peak_time.name: End of forecast peak gust hour within 24h

local_rain_counter.name: Local · Rain counter, period defined by the sensor

official_warning.name: Local official warning in available data

data_delayed.title: Some sScape observations are delayed
data_delayed.description: Some observations have been stale for at least five minutes. A newly generated assessment does not make its weather data new. Check Data quality and availability; do not treat missing data as an all-clear.

get_briefing.name: Read current briefing
get_briefing.description: Return the current assessment for the selected place. Does not operate devices. Administrator access required.

get_dashboard.name: Generate place dashboard
get_dashboard.description: Returns YAML and JSON configuration for preview. Does not create or modify dashboards. For guided creation open sScape setup. Administrator only.

get_outlook.name: Read upcoming weather windows
get_outlook.description: Return cached forecast rain windows, hourly gust peak and coldest hourly estimate. Does not operate devices. Administrator access required.

get_hazards.name: Read warnings and events
get_hazards.description: Returns current evidence, sources, distances and times without extra network requests. Catalogues may be partial. Administrator only.

get_setup.name: Read dashboard setup
get_setup.description: Lists selected targets and entities for preview. Does not return API keys or modify dashboards. Administrator only.
